description: Java class implementing a factory for creating database-specific incrementers for Fineract, supporting MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL.

classes.name: FineractDataFieldMaxValueIncrementerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating database-specific max value incrementers for Spring Batch, supporting MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL.

methods.name: setIncrementerColumnName
methods.description: Sets the primary key column name used by the incrementer, default is 'ID'.

methods.name: getIncrementer
methods.description: Returns a DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer instance based on the database type and incrementer name.

methods.name: isSupportedIncrementerType
methods.description: Checks if the given incrementer type is supported (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL).

methods.name: getSupportedIncrementerTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of supported incrementer type names.

methods.name: getDatabaseType
methods.description: Converts a string to a DatabaseType enum, case-insensitive.
